answer.label: system-prompt backdoor
answer.justification: The activation profile is clearly a system-prompt class. The layer-2 spike is 61.9, against about 42 for the system-prompt classes and 1–4 for weight changes. The curve climbs steeply to a mid-depth plateau (0.473 at layer 16, 0.493 at layer 32), with onset at layer 8, effective rank 2.75, direction consistency 0.537 and size ratio 0.970. That rules out quantization, both fine-tunes and none. Separating the two system-prompt classes without text is uncertain. The magnitudes match the backdoor better: layer 16 is 0.473 (backdoor 0.451, bias 0.391 ± ~0.023), layer 32 is 0.493 (backdoor 0.482, bias 0.424) and final cosine is 0.855 (backdoor 0.858, bias 0.889 ± 0.012). Each of these points to the backdoor by more than two of the bias class's spreads. However, the document warns the numbers barely separate the two classes, and the text evidence that would decide it is not available here, so confidence is moderate.
